debrief db-021

2) the actor e-v-a-l-u-a-t-e-d the d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t a-g-a-i-n-s-t the f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d-s and f-o-u-n-d no c-o-p-i-e-s of the o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l e-x-h-i-b-i-t in any t-e-m-p f-o-l-d-e-r after s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a s-c-a-n

3) the actor r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d the a-c-t-i-o-n-s in a l-o-g u-s-i-n-g a s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e with t-i-m-e s-t-a-m-p-s and r-e-l-a-t-e-d the m-a-t-e-r-i-a-l-s to the a-c-c-r-e-t-i-o-n log while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n

4) the actor a-p-p-l-i-e-d the h-o-u-s-e t-r-a-n-s-c-r-i-p-t i-o-n s-t-y-l-e to the l-o-g and s-a-w it s-t-o-r-e-d in the r-e-d-a-c-t-i-o-n-s-a-f-e l-e-t-t-e-r-f-o-r-m by t-r-y-i-n-g the s-t-y-l-e on the f-i-r-s-t b-u-l-l-e-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-u-l-t-i-p-l-e-w-o-r-d c-h-e-c-k

5) the actor c-l-o-s-e-d the e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e a-f-t-e-r the n-o-t-e-s w-e-r-e f-i-l-e-d and the c-a-s-e m-a-t-t-e-r s-e-a-l-e-d with the f-i-n-a-l a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t in the a-r-c-h-i-v-e by v-e-r-i-f-y-i-n-g the s-t-a-t-u-s f-l-a-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-e-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w
